The outing

🌳 Fred Fletcher Park

820 Clay Street, Raleigh, NC 27605 · Raleigh

Arrive 10 am, leave by 11 am · Museum admission is free · No sign-up needed

  • First 🌳 Fred Fletcher Park · map · if it’s dry
  • 10:45 am–11 am 🐾 Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat at NC Museum of Natural Sciences

Add to calendar

Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat at Fred Fletcher Park

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

Your toddler runs off energy at the playground, then watches the ocean habitat animals get fed at 10:45 am. It is a short outing that ends well before lunch and nap.

  • Have a snack at the park so they are not hungry during the feeding.
  • Say "one more slide, then the fish" about ten minutes before you go.
  • The feeding is only about 15 minutes, so head in a little early.

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 10 am–11:15 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    Sensory play, songs and stories in Hideaway Woods. It is a drop-in, so your child can stay as long as they like. It is included with museum admission.

    • Bring an extra layer for playing outside.
    • Let them pick the activity and stay as long as they like.

  • 📖 Toddler Storytime, then Apex Community Park

    Eva Perry Regional Library · Cary / Apex · 9:20 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Toddler Storytime at 9:30 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Then your child can play at Apex Community Park.

    • Ask at the Youth Services desk for a ticket.
    • Bring a snack for the park after storytime.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Leesville Community Park

    Leesville Community Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:50 am–11:10 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at 10:00 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Afterward your toddler can run around Leesville Community Park.

    • Bring a snack for after the stories.
    • Tell them the park comes next if they get wiggly.

  • 🌿 Beech Bluff County Park StoryWalk® 2026 (Self-Led)

    Beech Bluff County Park · South Wake · 9 am–10:15 am

    Map · Free · No sign-up needed

    Your toddler walks the Educational Loop and reads a picture book one page at a time. It is self-led, so you set the pace.

    • Let your child run ahead to find the next page.
    • Bring a snack for the end of the loop.

Or swap in

  • 🔬 Early Childhood Drop-In

    Hideaway Woods, Museum of Life and Science · Durham · 10 am–11:15 am

    Map · Included with museum admission · No sign-up needed

    Sensory play, songs and stories in Hideaway Woods. It is a drop-in, so your child can stay as long as they like. It is included with museum admission.

    • Bring an extra layer for playing outside.
    • Let them pick the activity and stay as long as they like.

  • 📅 Park Tales: If You Find a Leaf

    Historic Yates Mill County Park · Raleigh · 9:50 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up needed

    Park staff read a story about fall leaves, and your child can imagine what a leaf could be. A family needs to sign up first.

    • Pick up a real leaf and ask what it could be.
    • Bring a snack for after the story.

  • 🌳 Clemmons Educational State Forest

    East Wake · 9 am–10:30 am

    Map · Free

    A morning in the forest. Your toddler can walk the greenway and look for leaves, sticks and acorns.

    • Bring a snack for the picnic shelter.
    • Let them set the pace on the walk.

  • 🌳 Apex Nature Park

    Cary / Apex · 2 pm–3:30 pm

    Map · Free

    An easy afternoon walk on the greenway after nap. Your toddler can collect leaves and sticks.

    • Bring a snack for the picnic shelter.
    • Pack a bag for the leaves they collect.

  • 🌳 Blue Jay Point County Park

    North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 2:10 pm–3:40 pm

    Map · Free

    An afternoon at Blue Jay Point County Park with a playground and greenway. Your child can play and then wander the nature paths.

    • Play first and walk second, while they have energy.
    • Bring a snack for the picnic shelter.

  • 🌳 Fred Fletcher Park, then Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat

    Raleigh · 10 am–11 am

    Map · Museum admission is free · No sign-up needed

    Your toddler runs off energy at the playground, then watches the ocean habitat animals get fed at 10:45 am. It is a short outing that ends well before lunch and nap.

    • Have a snack at the park so they are not hungry during the feeding.
    • Say "one more slide, then the fish" about ten minutes before you go.
    • The feeding is only about 15 minutes, so head in a little early.

  • 🌳 Green Road Park, then Storytime Stay and Play

    North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:45 am–11:30 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your toddler plays at Green Road Park first. Then Storytime Stay and Play at 10:30 am has a story, then stations with playdough, building materials and crafts.

    • Have a snack at the park before you go in.
    • Let your child pick the station they like best and stay there.
    • Say goodbye to the last craft, then walk out together.

  • 📖 Toddler Storytime, then Apex Community Park

    Eva Perry Regional Library · Cary / Apex · 9:20 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Toddler Storytime at 9:30 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Then your child can play at Apex Community Park.

    • Ask at the Youth Services desk for a ticket.
    • Bring a snack for the park after storytime.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Leesville Community Park

    Leesville Community Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:50 am–11:10 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at 10:00 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Afterward your toddler can run around Leesville Community Park.

    • Bring a snack for after the stories.
    • Tell them the park comes next if they get wiggly.

  • 🌿 Beech Bluff County Park StoryWalk® 2026 (Self-Led)

    Beech Bluff County Park · South Wake · 9 am–10:15 am

    Map · Free · No sign-up needed

    Your toddler walks the Educational Loop and reads a picture book one page at a time. It is self-led, so you set the pace.

    • Let your child run ahead to find the next page.
    • Bring a snack for the end of the loop.

  • 🌳 Elevate Fitness Course, then Family Storytime

    Cary / Apex · 9:50 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your toddler plays at Elevate Fitness Course first. Then Family Storytime at 10:30 am has books, music, rhymes and movement.

    • Ask at the Youth Services desk for a ticket.
    • Snack at the park before storytime.

  • 🌳 White Deer Park

    South Wake · 3 pm–4:10 pm

    Map · Free

    A relaxed afternoon after nap at White Deer Park, with a playground and greenway. Your toddler can play and wander.

    • Bring a snack for after nap.
    • Start for the car before they get tired.

  • 🌳 Fred Fletcher Park, then Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat

    Raleigh · 10 am–11 am

    Map · Museum admission is free · No sign-up needed

    Your toddler runs off energy at the playground, then watches the ocean habitat animals get fed at 10:45 am. It is a short outing that ends well before lunch and nap.

    • Have a snack at the park so they are not hungry during the feeding.
    • Say "one more slide, then the fish" about ten minutes before you go.
    • The feeding is only about 15 minutes, so head in a little early.

  • 🌳 Green Road Park, then Storytime Stay and Play

    North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:45 am–11:30 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your toddler plays at Green Road Park first. Then Storytime Stay and Play at 10:30 am has a story, then stations with playdough, building materials and crafts.

    • Have a snack at the park before you go in.
    • Let your child pick the station they like best and stay there.
    • Say goodbye to the last craft, then walk out together.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Leesville Community Park

    Leesville Community Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:50 am–11:10 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at 10:00 am has books, music, rhymes and movement. Afterward your toddler can run around Leesville Community Park.

    • Bring a snack for after the stories.
    • Tell them the park comes next if they get wiggly.

  • 🌳 Elevate Fitness Course, then Family Storytime

    Cary / Apex · 9:50 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your toddler plays at Elevate Fitness Course first. Then Family Storytime at 10:30 am has books, music, rhymes and movement.

    • Ask at the Youth Services desk for a ticket.
    • Snack at the park before storytime.

  • 🌳 White Deer Park

    South Wake · 5 pm–6:10 pm

    Map · Free

    A relaxed afternoon after nap at White Deer Park, with a playground and greenway. Your toddler can play and wander.

    • Bring a snack for after nap.
    • Start for the car before they get tired.
